name: Voice-first second brain for Apple Watch

mentions.name: Voice-first second brain for Apple Watch
mentions.description: This Apple Watch app is a voice-first second brain that captures thoughts instantly from the wrist using the Ultra's Action button or Siri keywords, without needing an iPhone nearby (using cellular or Wi-Fi). Audio is transcribed using EU-based speech-to-text with zero data retention and turned into searchable notes and summaries.
mentions.problem: Capturing a thought before forgetting it, without having to pull out the phone.
mentions.source_excerpt:
I’m building a voice-first second brain for Apple Watch. The idea is simple: capture thoughts instantly from your wrist using the Ultra’s Action button or Siri keywords, without needing your iPhone nearby (using cellular or wi-fi).

Audio is transcribed using EU-based speech-to-text with zero data retention, then turned into searchable notes and summaries.
mentions.author: ofisboy
